An Executive Director’s employment contract may be terminated either through;
• Voluntary Termination – Through wilful termination by the Executive Director;
• Involuntary Termination – By reason of disability, retrenchment, retirement or as determined by the Board in good faith; and
• Adverse Termination – By reason for cause (e.g. serious misconduct, negligence, criminal guilt, bankruptcy, poor performance and/or any other material
breach of their employment contract).
In determining overall termination arrangements, the BHRC will distinguish between types of termination and the circumstances of the termination.
The BHRC would also consider all relevant circumstances, including whether a contractual provision in the Director’s arrangements complied with best
practice at the time of termination and the date the provision was agreed, as well as the performance of the Director in certain respects.
Where appropriate, the BHRC may consider providing certain benefits relating to termination including the provision of outplacement support.
